Our Story

Laze Wear was built on one idea — that comfort shouldn't be something you trade for style. Every piece is made to move with you, not against you: oversized, heavyweight, unbothered by trend cycles.

Nationwide Delivery

We deliver across Pakistan via trusted courier partners. Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days of confirmation.

Most orders reach major cities within 2–4 business days and other areas within 4–7 business days, depending on your location and courier availability.

Our tees are an oversized, relaxed fit and currently run S to XL. If you're between sizes, message us on WhatsApp and we'll help you pick the right one.

Size exchanges are accepted within 3 days of delivery, as long as the item is unworn and in original condition. Just reach out to us on WhatsApp to start the process.
